jobgether-jobgether:lever:0394d2da-e9c8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a RVP, Customer Growth based in the United States. This is a senior sales leadership opportunity focused on driving regional growth for a leading cloud-based business platform. You will lead, coach, and develop a high-performing sales organization while remaining actively involved in strategic customer engagements. The role combines regional sales strategy, executive relationship management, account penetration, competitive positioning, and team development. You will work directly with C-level decision-makers to articulate compelling business value and guide complex opportunities through to close. Success will require strong commercial judgment, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to operate across functions, industries, and time zones. You will also collaborate with alliance partners and internal teams to strengthen market presence and accelerate revenue growth. The position offers significant visibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to shape sales performance across a strategic U.S. region. Lead regional sales: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing sales organization across the assigned region while maintaining accountability for revenue and growth objectives. Drive sales execution: Establish regional sales plans covering targeted accounts, sub-regions, and vertical segments, and ensure consistent execution against business priorities. Coach and enable the team: Train sales professionals on sales processes, best practices, business-value selling, and Challenger-style approaches, while supporting onboarding, certification, and ongoing development. Manage strategic opportunities: Engage directly with C-level prospects and decision-makers, develop executive-level proposals, position strategic value, negotiate effectively, and drive complex opportunities through closure. Develop account strategies: Build account penetration models that create multiple avenues into strategic customers and identify opportunities for expansion, competitive displacement, cross-selling, and upselling. Strengthen value messaging: Align messaging to the priorities of economic buyers and develop compelling value propositions based on customer business challenges and measurable outcomes. Execute regional campaigns: Lead field sales campaigns targeting priority verticals and competitive take-out opportunities while adapting sales enablement content to regional needs. Maintain sales visibility: Deliver regular regional sales updates and ensure Salesforce and other systems of record contain accurate pipeline, account, and forecasting information. Build competitive advantage: Develop localized competitive positioning and messaging to help sales teams differentiate effectively in the market. Collaborate across the ecosystem: Partner with internal functional and regional teams as well as in-country alliance partners to maximize customer and commercial outcomes. Represent the region: Provide leadership, strategic insight, and executive presence across customer, prospect, partner, and internal stakeholder engagements. Requirements Sales leadership experience: 5–10 years of successful sales management and individual-contributor experience, including at least 3 years with the same organization and a demonstrable record of achievement. SaaS expertise: Strong experience selling complex cloud-based or SaaS solutions in enterprise environments. Commercial performance: Proven ability to personally deliver against sales targets while simultaneously recruiting, developing, and managing high-performing sales talent. Strategic selling: Ability to identify complex customer challenges and translate them into compelling, differentiated value propositions focused on measurable business outcomes. Executive engagement: Demonstrated success engaging stakeholders at all organizational levels, from functional leaders through C-suite executives.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3e6ab88d-76d8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Developer RD-018 based in Canada. This is an opportunity to contribute to the development and evolution of a well-established SaaS platform focused on stakeholder relationship management and ESG initiatives. You will work across the full technology stack to design, build, and deploy scalable features that address real customer needs. The role combines hands-on development with opportunities to influence architecture, engineering practices, and technical decisions. You will join a collaborative, multidisciplinary, and international team where technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are encouraged. Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into the development environment, offering opportunities to use modern AI tools to improve productivity and software quality. You will have meaningful ownership of your work while contributing to an evolving product and improving the processes and technologies behind it. This role is well suited to an autonomous, curious developer who enjoys solving complex problems and building reliable software with a team. Design, develop, test, and deploy new features and enhancements across the SaaS platform. Contribute to technical decisions and the ongoing evolution of the application's software architecture. Develop high-performing, scalable, secure, and stable solutions that meet customer and business requirements. Collaborate with multidisciplinary team members to identify requirements, evaluate options, and implement effective technical solutions. Participate actively in Agile development practices, including sprint planning, task estimation, prioritization, and delivery. Conduct code reviews and share technical knowledge and best practices with colleagues. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development methodologies, engineering tools, workflows, and CI/CD processes. Use AI-powered development tools responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and innovation. Monitor emerging technologies and software engineering practices and assess opportunities to incorporate relevant improvements. Help maintain a strong engineering culture centered on quality, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer value. Requirements: Degree or formal education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 3–5 years of professional software development experience . Strong proficiency in Node.js and React , with demonstrated full-stack development capabilities. Experience with Git and established software development, version control, testing, and code quality practices. Professional fluency in both French and English , written and spoken. Experience with technologies such as TypeScript, Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GitLab, Mocha, Puppeteer, Jest, ESLint, or Cursor is an asset. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to diagnosing and resolving technical challenges. Curiosity and a genuine interest in learning new technologies, frameworks, and development approaches. Collaborative mindset and willingness to participate in technical discussions, peer reviews, and knowledge sharing. Ability to work autonomously, organize priorities effectively, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. Strong commitment to product quality and continuous improvement of both technical processes and customer-facing solutions. Benefits: CAD $85,000–$90,000 annual base salary , with the final offer determined according to experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors. Permanent, full-time employment. 100% remote work environment within Canada. Flexible 37.5-hour work week . Collaborative and international team environment. Opportunity to work on a well-established and continuously evolving SaaS product.

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:52e2ff.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As our Chief of Staff, you will act as a force multiplier for the leadership team, driving alignment, ensuring execution, and creating leverage across the business. This role is for someone who is hungry and has exceptionally high agency. You should thrive on ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to create value without waiting for direction. No task is too big or too small. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Partner with the CEO and leadership team to prioritize, execute, and track progress on the highest-impact strategic initiatives across the company - Streamline decision-making, manage leadership cadences, and ensure follow-through on commitments to create leverage for leadership - Work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Growth, and Customer Success to close gaps, accelerate progress, and unlock new opportunities - Build trust and alignment across teams to enable collaboration without relying on formal reporting lines - Step into ambiguous, high-priority efforts such as launching new processes, tackling operational bottlenecks, or testing new growth levers - Provide strategic input, surface insights, and help shape the future direction of Profound WHO YOU ARE - Hungry and high-agency operator, ambitious, driven, and proactive, seeing gaps and filling them without waiting for permission - Experienced owner with a background as a product manager, founder, or early operator, owning outcomes end to end - Collaborative leader skilled at influencing and driving alignment across teams without formal authority - Strategic and tactical, equally comfortable thinking big picture and diving into execution details, with no task too big or too small - Resilient and resourceful, thriving in ambiguity, adapting quickly, and biasing toward action LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $150,000 to $200,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-DNI Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? Parking Lot Attendants are responsible for ensuring all vehicles come out clean from the car wash tunnel. The Parking Lot Attendant engages with all customers and members. They are responsible for maintaining and replenishing all car wash cleaning products for our members and keeping a clean workspace. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done!
